verdict.rationale: AngelList documents bulk e-sign, which lets administrators sign an unlimited number of documents at once (angellist-docs-25). Equity Blocks let boards pre-approve standard grants so each grant no longer needs its own approval (angellist-docs-24), and HRIS integrations automatically sync terminations (angellist-docs-22). Bulk capability is otherwise limited to these specific workflows, and the OpenAPI probe found no public API spec at any candidate path, so there is no evidence of scriptable bulk operations (angellist-probe-2). Missing for 10: general bulk edit/import across cap-table items, an API or programmatic bulk interface for AI-native workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk features.
